analysis.reason: No tests returned meaningful real data to the 'out' port.
analysis.description: Test 1 outputs to the 'out' port but the data contains only undefined values ({ 'Automation ID': undefined, Name: undefined, Status: undefined }), which indicates no real data was returned — this does not constitute a meaningful passing test. Test 2 outputs to an 'unknown' port and appears to be a validation/configuration check rather than a functional test of the ListAutomations component. Neither test demonstrates that the component successfully retrieves and returns actual automation data.
